items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1958-08-08; 1958-09-03
items.q: He came back and he lived at Jones' house. John Rovershire.

ctx.x: Transposed, yeah. Do you remember Fess if he ever came back to New Orleans later or died there or anything? Who was that? McCurdy?
He came back. He came back and he lived at Jones' house. John Rovershire.
John Rovershire. And he died there in the city then? Oh, he did? You remember?
